assets: 10 US value-weighted industry portfolios including dividends
units: Percent per month; beta dimensionless; alpha percent per month
market: Mkt-RF is already excess market return; do not subtract RF again
rf: Monthly RF from the same Fama/French factor file, not annual yield

factors: This file was created using the 202609 CRSP database.
The 1-month TBill rate data until 202405 are from Ibbotson Associates. Starting from 202406, the 1-month TBill rate is from ICE BofA US 1-Month Treasury Bill Index.
The annual TBill return is compounded from the monthly T-bill rates from January to December.
industries: This file was created using the 202609 CRSP database.
It contains value- and equal-weighted returns for 10 industry portfolios.
The portfolios are constructed at the end of June.
The annual returns are from January to December.
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.

identity: This is a US industry example, not the earlier A-share stock basket.
point_in_time: Latest downloaded historical vintage, not a reconstructed real-time vintage.
rights: Provider retains rights; local educational analysis. No claim of an open redistribution license.
classroom_policy: Read these two fixed files; never download or generate random data during examples or rendering.
